<!-- What does this change do? Concise, but concrete. -->

<!-- Why is it needed? The problem or the outcome behind it. -->

<!-- The implementation changes that matter. -->

## Risk / Compatibility

<!-- Regression, security, migration, API, config, schema, or performance risk.

<!-- What documentation changed. If none was needed, say why. -->

<!-- The highest-risk code, the design decision, or the unresolved trade-off.
